sponsor_or_proposer: ORLEN S.A. (formerly Grupa LOTOS) in consortium with Operator Gazociągów Przesyłowych GAZ-SYSTEM
current_state: Onshore small-scale LNG handling/logistics depot concept near the Gdańsk Refinery (Martwa Wisła river), distinct from the Gulf of Gdańsk FSRU already in GEM. Feasibility study completed (~2020-2021); as of an Orlen statement reported 28 Apr 2026 the project is still in the technical/economic analysis phase, with plots only 'provisionally earmarked' behind the Gdańsk Refinery and a possible 2029-2030 horizon contingent on approvals and acquisition of the floating unit or onshore infrastructure. No investment decision (FID), permit application, or FEED contract reported.
missing_threshold_elements: concrete step (no FID / no permit filing / no construction decision — feasibility complete but stalled in analysis since ~2020, site only provisionally earmarked)
watch_for: ORLEN/Gaz-System investment decision (FID), environmental/building permit filing, site lease at the Gdańsk Refinery, or a clear split of this small-scale/onshore-storage concept from the Gulf of Gdańsk FSRU into a separately-named project. Re-check ~6-12 months.
notes: Sponsor identified and approximate location present, so it passes those two threshold elements; held below the bar on the concrete-step test because the feasibility study (done ~2020-2021) has not advanced to an investment decision and the Apr-2026 Orlen framing is 'remains a possibility after 2029'. Verified URLs: biznes.pap.pl PAP article (PASS, tokens 'Gdansk','Orlen'); orlen.pl small-scale LNG product page (PASS). NOT to be confused with the in-GEM 'Polish Baltic Sea Coast FSRU' (T100000130731, Gdańsk Bay) — that is the offshore FSRU + FSRU-2 expansion, a different facility.
